### Full Job Description
Summary:
Senior Backend Engineer building scalable Golang microservices for Weave’s healthcare payments platform. Leading architecture, reliability, and cross-functional delivery.
Senior Backend Engineer building Golang payment services for Weave’s healthcare platform
Role description:
• Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services and APIs using Golang microservices
• Drive technical architecture and anticipate scaling and maintenance needs
• Collaborate with product, design, and frontend teams to deliver high-impact features
• Participate in system design reviews and contribute to engineering strategy
• Own code quality, reliability, and observability from development through production
• Plan and execute projects from inception to delivery
• Mentor peers and junior engineers
• Participate in on-call rotation and escalation, supporting critical incidents
• Establish operational excellence standards, including SLAs/SLOs, monitoring, alerting, and incident response processes
• Work on Weave’s payments platform, which supports healthcare practices with scheduling, payments, communication, and reviews
Role requirements:
• 5+ years of backend engineering experience with modern programming languages such as Golang, Java, Python, Ruby, or C#
• Golang preferred or willingness to learn
• Experience designing and building RESTful APIs and backend services
• Strong understanding of distributed systems and inter-service communication, including protobufs/gRPC, REST, Kafka, and Redis
• Experience with relational databases and SQL
• Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation and take responsibility for production systems
• Experience deploying and maintaining services in cloud environments, especially Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
• Comfort with Docker/Kubernetes, observability tooling, metrics, alerts, tracing, and service reliability
• Experience with protobufs/gRPC or Temporal
• Experience breaking monoliths into microservices
• Successful completion of a background check
• Current U.S. work authorization status is requested in the application

• Equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive workplace
• Reasonable accommodation for disabilities or special needs
• AI-assisted candidate experience
• No specific compensation extras or benefits stated

Cloud, Distributed Systems, Docker, Google Cloud Platform, GRPC, Java, Kafka, Kubernetes, Microservices, Python, Redis, Ruby, SQL, Go
